name: OpenAI Multi-Agent Hide-and-Seek
description: Multi-agent reinforcement learning environment from OpenAI where teams of hiders and seekers compete in a physically simulated 3D environment with movable objects. The environment famously demonstrated emergent tool use and strategic innovation including ramp-surfing and box-locking through pure self-play.
typical_sota_score: Demonstrated successive emergent strategies through prolonged self-play; not a standardised leaderboard.
reputation: Highly influential demonstration of emergent multi-agent behaviour; widely cited in RL and AI research on self-play and tool use.
notes: Environment code released but not actively maintained; requires significant compute for training. Primarily of scientific interest as an emergence demonstration.
